causal_influence.principle: Delete accepted state and compare only later public decisions.

complete_cold_reduction.principle: Rebuild every selected stream-arm numerator before pooled results.

mechanical_safety.principle: Reject invalid transactions and preserve exact bytes.

opportunity_accounting.principle: Keep harm, miss, zero-admission, and no-headroom denominators.

upstream_efficacy.principle: Promotion requires the frozen upstream value gate.

efficacy_verdict.upstream_honest_verdict: complete_null: admission learning completed but frozen value gates failed: future_error_vs_reset,future_error_vs_unconditional_recognition,false_accept_vs_reset,false_accept_vs_unconditional_recognition,recurrence_degradation_vs_frozen_warmup,recurrence_error_vs_label_shuffled_admission

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declare models executable in this invocation; keep historical identities in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each criterion records expected, observed, passed, and principle; separate completeness and value.
field_principles.admission_audit_complete_score: One means the complete cold audit and all dispositions are present, including nulls.
field_principles.admission_promotion_score: One requires upstream value plus independent safety, causality, and opportunity accounting.
field_principles.causal_influence_verdict: Report later prediction influence separately from safety and efficacy.
field_principles.causal_intervention_rows: Accepted-update deletion changes only later predictions when a genuine learning effect exists.
field_principles.cold_restore_rows: Retain cold identity, interrupted commits, rejected updates, and exact rollback.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC audit end.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.efficacy_verdict: Preserve the upstream frozen value result without reinterpretation.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host orchestration is host; identify device execution separately.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind evidence to the active Exp7283 task.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumer values remain ordinary top-level fields.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked results name upstream, exact check, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation, not an invented task label.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the correct no-LLM class and never pad duration.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generation from usable answers.
field_principles.mechanical_safety_verdict: Report transaction safety separately from learning value.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive from actual calls, including failed or unusable generation.
field_principles.no_model_weight_mutation: Constraint-state replay must not mutate model weights.
field_principles.opportunity_accounting_verdict: Require full harm and missed-benefit denominators.
field_principles.opportunity_reduction: Independent denominators prevent all-reject safety from becoming a learning headline.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record actual input hashes, authority separation, resource ownership, and failures.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before observing results.
field_principles.reducer_inference_substrate: Identify the read-only reducer as upstream aggregation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, input manifests, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep each unit, arm, seed, error, abstention, cost, metric, and censoring state.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913 and actual UTC start and end times.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, and censored units and the stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact input identity, retirement, and quarantine status.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC invocation start.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked for terminal evidence; keep unfinished work in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, timing, and log hash; do not hide failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed terminal classes; oracle authority forbids positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared verifier authority; exact conformance is not learned correctness.

historical_e2e_scope: E2E-007 principles only; Exp1659 was not rerun
honest_verdict: complete_null: cold admission audit completed; upstream efficacy value gate failed

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: reduce each selected sealed stream once; preserve every null and censored unit
